req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /tasks endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-025 requires that every /tasks/* endpoint returning a body must respond with Content-Type: application/json. We test: (1) EP positive – GET /tasks/ returns 200 with exact application/json content-type; (2) EP positive – POST /tasks/ returns 201 with exact application/json content-type; (3) EP positive – GET /tasks/{id} returns 200 with exact application/json content-type; (4) EP positive – PUT /tasks/{id} returns 200 with exact application/json content-type; (5) NEG – GET /tasks/{nonexistent_id} returns 404 with application/json content-type (error body still JSON); (6) BVA – DELETE /tasks/{id} returns 204 with NO body, so content-type assertion is not applicable but status must be exactly 204; (7) BVA – GET /tasks/ with skip=0 and limit=1 boundary returns application/json. Each test uses in-process FastAPI TestClient with pre-loaded fixture data, asserts exact status codes and exact content-type header values to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type
preconditions: Database contains 20 pre-loaded task rows
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send GET /tasks/ with no query parameters
expected: Response body is a non-empty JSON array
trace: R-TASK-025: GET /tasks/ returns body -> must have application/json Content-Type
tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r025_1.db')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine, SessionLocal
from app import crud, schemas

def test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type():
    models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    db = SessionLocal()
    db.add(models.Task(title='Read chapter 5', description='Signal pulse ember', completed=True))
    db.add(models.Task(title='Book flight tickets', description='Delta willow vertex', completed=True))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/tasks/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) >= 2

test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_delete_task_204_no_body_no_json_content_type_required
preconditions: Database contains at least one task
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
expected: Subsequent GET /tasks/{task_id} returns 404 with application/json Content-Type
trace: R-TASK-025: DELETE /tasks/{id} returns 204 NO CONTENT — no body, so JSON content-type not required; boundary between body-returning and no-body endpoints
tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r025_6.db')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine

def test_delete_task_204_no_body_no_json_content_type_required():
    models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    client = TestClient(app)
    created = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Run unit tests', 'completed': False})
    assert created.status_code == 201
    task_id = created.json()['id']
    r = client.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b''
    r2 = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    ct2 = r2.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct2

test_delete_task_204_no_body_no_json_content_type_required()
